english.note: Use this for the sharp pain in the side caused by running, other exercise, or sometimes laughing.

examples.english: I got a stitch after two laps, so I had to stop and catch my breath.
examples.traditional: 我跑咗兩個圈就岔氣，唯有停低抖吓。
